title: The 75 new atlas cells
caption: Every new and renamed item of the five rosters, baked from the reviewed drafts into fw-icons.png (rows 13–22), in roster order: humans, elves, dwarves, reptilians, gnomes.

title: Ironvein’s merchant: the dwarves’ gear on the shelf
caption: An Ironvein contract leans its shelf to its people: Hand Hammer and Deepforge Plate (dwarves), Glaive (reptilians). Every piece is a new kind with its own icon.

title: A new ware’s card: Pepperport Sabre
caption: Its rolled base (+8 damage, +12% speed) and its fixed edge, said as the effect alone: “Crits burn 12/s for 3s”.

title: Hand Hammer: hits hard, a small stun
caption: The edge (8% stun 0.5s) sits under the base lines; the hand rule last.

title: A Level 2 skill choice with two new cards
caption: Hero at level 10: Thornbloom (renamed), Venom Spit and Overgrowth (new). Venom Spit focused.

title: The same offer, Overgrowth focused
caption: Overgrowth grows roots on the path beside its hero (the Snare’s hazard): slows 40%, stings 8/s.

title: Codex · Items: 100 kinds, each its own icon
caption: The classic kinds first, then the five rosters in order. Badge is the level; the corner crest is the company that deals it more often.

title: Codex card: Kite Shield
caption: Level 1 · Off hand · Peppercorn Co. “Holds 2 enemies; its hits slow 15%.”

title: Codex · Skills: the renames and the five new cards
caption: Spicy Peps, Starweave, Blood Price, Thornbloom (renamed); Bolder Bash, Banner Bearer, Venom Spit, Overgrowth, Tinker’s Spark (new).

title: Codex card: Bolder Bash, Ironvein’s new signature
caption: Paid at standing 5 on Ironvein’s track; Ore Sense becomes an ordinary card.

title: In battle: the dressed company
caption: Knight with Hand Hammer + Anvil Shield (the shield is drawn on the arm), the gnome caster with a Sprout Wand in her fist, an elf with a Recurve Bow, a reptilian with a Spear.

title: On the figure: the humans’ new kinds
caption: Real draw code (harness/kit.html?peoples=1). Every blade swings the knight’s painted sword (the rule); the new shields are drawn on the arm.

title: On the figure: the elves’ new kinds
caption: The bows are the archer’s painted bow; knives are not drawn on the hooded look; the quivers on the knight.

title: On the figure: the dwarves’ new kinds
caption: Hammers and axes swing the painted sword with their glint; Round, Rune, Anvil Shield and Thane’s Bulwark on the arm.

title: On the figure: the reptilians’ new kinds
caption: Spears, cleavers and the glaive swing the painted sword; Gator Buckler and Javelin Sling in the off hand.

title: On the figure: the gnomes’ new kinds
caption: The casters hold their own cell: Sprout Wand, Thornrod, Spark Coil, Bloomstaff, Worldroot Staff. Pouch, flask, rack and elixir on the knight.
